title: Enterprise Integration Patterns
author: Gregor Hohpe and Bobby Woolf
why: The classic vocabulary for messaging: point-to-point channels, publish-subscribe channels, competing consumers, polling and event-driven consumers. The website summarises each pattern for free.

title: Queue-Based Load Leveling pattern
author: Microsoft Azure Architecture Center
why: A short, vendor-neutral write-up of using a queue to buffer spikes, with when not to use it.

title: Competing Consumers pattern
author: Microsoft Azure Architecture Center
why: How multiple workers share one queue, plus the ordering and poison-message issues that come with it.
